name: sidenav
title: Sidenav
description: Off-canvas navigation drawer with edge swipe gestures, user view, subheaders and collapsible groups, or a fixed desktop sidenav.
improvements: Radix Dialog drawer: focus is trapped, Escape closes it and focus returns to the trigger.
The overlay is unmounted with the drawer, so it never stays after closing (#3872).
Swipe-to-open and drag-to-close use Pointer Events with touch-action: pan-y and honour reduced motion.
The edge drag target is rendered by React and removed on unmount instead of leaking into <body>.
variant="fixed" renders a static <nav> from a breakpoint up and a drawer below it.
